meta.label: K8S Insights
meta.description: Deterministic rule engine that audits any DSS-managed EKS cluster: collects kubectl + filesystem probes, runs 30+ rules, returns ranked findings with concrete remediation. Runs on the target DSS host so kubectl and the local DSS managed-cluster directory are reachable.

params.name: cluster_id
params.label: Cluster ID
params.description: DSS managed cluster identifier (directory under $DIP_HOME/clusters/). When empty, the first cluster found is used.

params.name: rules_filter
params.label: Rule filter (CSV)
params.description: Optional comma-separated list of rule IDs to evaluate. Empty = all rules.

params.name: namespace
params.label: Namespace
params.description: Namespace of the pod to inspect (describe-pod operation only).

params.name: pod_name
params.label: Pod name
params.description: Name of the pod to inspect (describe-pod operation only).
